summary: John's 1st cousin 5x removed (daughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney).
bio: Catherine Heffernan (1833-1908) married Edmund Grimes; a WikiTree profile gives her birthplace as County Tipperary in 1836 (no specific citation for the county), an early clue to the family's Tipperary origin. Sons Richard E. Grimes (c.1858-1909, killed at the Boston D&H colliery) and Edmund D. Grimes (d. 1927 in a California mine accident).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
